lines: AMIT DILIP SHAH, an investor selling shareholder, is due proceeds from selling 84,600 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of up to ₹5.92 crore are scheduled on or about Friday, October 23, 2026, per the offer timetable, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Retained shares face a 6-month lock-in from allotment, so any remaining holding may mean further money later.
Pre-offer holding and average cost of acquisition are not confirmed, so the retained value and gain cannot be stated.
